parsed.post: Kept the improvement (0.9828 -> 0.9799). Lowering LR to 0.04 seems to provide more stability for DEPTH=6 than the previous 0.05. Next: testing if increasing the WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 further smooths training or if we should push for more capacity like the others.
parsed.description: Increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 to see if a longer warmup period further stabilizes the training of the DEPTH=6 model with MATRIX_LR=0.04.
